title: Spec sizing: root-signed DIO (0x17 + version-auth options) exceeds the 254-byte link frame when carried uncompressed
description: Found by worker-1 while executing b7z9.88.2's round-trip test (root_dio_signature_roundtrip_produces_and_advances, currently #[ignore]d with this cause). MEASURED: build_authenticated_dio emits ~230B of DIO (base 27 + config ~10 + version-auth ~85 + 0x17 signature ~124 covering the COSE_Sign1) but the LICHEN link frame caps at LICHEN_MAX_FRAME_LEN=254 and the stack's uncompressed control path (send_ipv6_uncompressed_to) carries the whole IPv6 packet: IPv6 40 + rpl_code 1 + DIO ~230 = ~271 > 254. send_ipv6_uncompressed_to returns TxError::BufferTooSmall. WITHOUT the 0x17 signature (~147B) it fits - which is why all pre-signature DIO tests pass. DECISION NEEDED (same family as ljgs): (a) fragment/Block-wise DIOs, (b) SCHC-compress the control plane, (c) shrink the COSE payload (e.g. drop version-auth duplication - the receiver already has version from the DIO base header... but it must be signed), or (d) raise the link frame cap. Note the 0x17 signature covers version/rank/mop so the receiver's cross-check requires the FULL signed payload on wire. Interim: the producer + feature are correct and committed; the round-trip test is #[ignore]d pending the decision. Closes only with the round-trip green.
